schemes.name: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana
schemes.description: Monthly cash assistance to destitute men, women, orphans, disabled persons, and other listed vulnerable categories with no means of support.
schemes.description_mr: Monthly cash assistance to destitute men, women, orphans, disabled persons, and other listed vulnerable categories with no means of support.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 1,500 per month (single beneficiary); rate is higher per NSAP-linked category when combined with central top-up.
schemes.benefit_mr: Rs. 1,500 per month (single beneficiary); rate is higher per NSAP-linked category when combined with central top-up.
schemes.notes: Official page states income ceiling as EITHER family annual income up to Rs 21,000 OR being on the BPL list — this OR condition cannot be expressed by max_income alone. Age range (18-65) applies to the general destitute category; several sub-categories (disabled, terminally ill, abuse survivors, unmarried women 35+, prisoners' wives) have no stated age band on this page. Document list is NOT itemized on the official page — the list above is the standard document set used across Social Justice Dept. (SJSA) anudan schemes and should be verified before production use.

schemes.name: Shravan Bal Seva Rajya Nivruttivetan Yojana
schemes.description: State old-age pension for senior citizens who are below the poverty line or below a low income threshold.
schemes.description_mr: State old-age pension for senior citizens who are below the poverty line or below a low income threshold.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 1,500 per month per beneficiary.
schemes.benefit_mr: Rs. 1,500 per month per beneficiary.
schemes.notes: Same OR-condition caveat as Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar (BPL listing OR income <Rs 21,000). Document list not itemized on official page; inferred from standard SJSA anudan application format.

schemes.name: Ramai Awas Yojana
schemes.description: Housing subsidy scheme to construct pucca houses for Scheduled Caste and Neo-Buddhist families.
schemes.description_mr: Housing subsidy scheme to construct pucca houses for Scheduled Caste and Neo-Buddhist families.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 1.32 lakh in plain rural areas (incl. Rs 12,000 for toilet); Rs. 1.42 lakh in hilly/Naxal-affected areas; Rs. 2.50 lakh in Municipal Council/Corporation areas.
schemes.benefit_mr: Rs. 1.32 lakh in plain rural areas (incl. Rs 12,000 for toilet); Rs. 1.42 lakh in hilly/Naxal-affected areas; Rs. 2.50 lakh in Municipal Council/Corporation areas.
schemes.notes: max_income of Rs 1,20,000 applies to RURAL areas specifically (relevant for a Gram Panchayat context); the urban ceiling is Rs 3,00,000 and cannot be represented alongside the rural figure with a single max_income key — pick per area type. Caste category (SC/Neo-Buddhist) is a hard eligibility gate that cannot be expressed with the given keys; also requires the applicant NOT be on the SECC-2011 priority list (i.e., not already eligible under PMAY-G), a mutual-exclusion rule the schema cannot represent. No dedicated online application URL was found — selection runs through the Gram Sabha, so form_url points to the informational page, not an application form.

schemes.name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana
schemes.name_mr: महात्मा जोतिराव फुले जन आरोग्य योजना
schemes.description: Cashless health insurance scheme providing free surgeries and treatments through empanelled network hospitals for economically weaker ration-card holding families.
schemes.description_mr: Cashless health insurance scheme providing free surgeries and treatments through empanelled network hospitals for economically weaker ration-card holding families.
schemes.benefit: Cashless hospitalisation cover of Rs. 1,50,000 per family per year (floater); renal transplant capped at Rs. 2,50,000 including one year of immunosuppressive therapy.
schemes.benefit_mr: Cashless hospitalisation cover of Rs. 1,50,000 per family per year (floater); renal transplant capped at Rs. 2,50,000 including one year of immunosuppressive therapy.

required_documents.name: Yellow or Orange Ration Card with Aadhaar number
Government photo ID (interim, until health card issued)

schemes.notes: IMPORTANT GAP: the fetched official page describes the scheme's original 2013-era structure (Yellow/Orange/Antyodaya/Annapurna card holders, explicitly limited to 8 districts, White card holders excluded). Since 2020 MJPJAY has been merged with Ayushman Bharat-PMJAY (AB-MJPJAY) and public reporting indicates it now covers all ration-card categories statewide across all 36 districts — but I could not locate and fetch a current official maharashtra.gov.in/jeevandayee.gov.in page confirming the present-day statewide/all-category rules within the allowed source list in this session. Do NOT use the '8 districts' or 'White card excluded' facts for a current-year product without re-verifying against a current jeevandayee.gov.in or NHA page. No numeric age/income eligibility exists for this scheme — eligibility is entirely ration-card-category based, which cannot be expressed with the given criteria keys.

schemes.name: Shabari Awas Yojana
schemes.description: Housing subsidy scheme to construct pucca houses for homeless Scheduled Tribe families.
schemes.description_mr: Housing subsidy scheme to construct pucca houses for homeless Scheduled Tribe families.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 1.20 lakh for construction of a 269 sq. ft. house.
schemes.benefit_mr: Rs. 1.20 lakh for construction of a 269 sq. ft. house.
schemes.notes: Sourced from a Zilla Parishad (Akola) district government page rather than a direct state tribal-development-department page, since the department's own scheme page could not be reached in this session — treat as high-confidence on the numeric facts (matches the same figures used across multiple ZP portals) but re-verify against adivasi.maharashtra.gov.in before production use. Caste category (ST) is a hard gate not expressible with the given keys. No online application URL found; applications are typically routed through the Gram Panchayat/ITDP office, not a web portal.

schemes.name: Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin (household toilet incentive)
schemes.description: Construction incentive for eligible rural households to build and use an individual household toilet.
schemes.description_mr: पात्र ग्रामीण कुटुंबांना वैयक्तिक शौचालय बांधण्यासाठी प्रोत्साहन अनुदान.
schemes.benefit: Rs 12,000 incentive per household for a twin-pit toilet
schemes.benefit_mr: दुहेरी खड्डा शौचालयासाठी प्रति कुटुंब ₹१२,००० प्रोत्साहन
schemes.notes: All BPL households qualify, plus listed above-poverty-line categories. Modelled as an any_of group; the woman-headed-household path is covered by is_head plus gender in practice but is not encoded here.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
schemes.description: A government-guaranteed savings account for a girl child, maturing 21 years after opening.
schemes.description_mr: मुलीच्या नावे शासन हमी असलेले बचत खाते, उघडल्यापासून २१ वर्षांनी परिपक्व.
schemes.benefit: Deposits of Rs 250 to Rs 1,50,000 a year at the notified SSY interest rate
schemes.benefit_mr: दरवर्षी ₹२५० ते ₹१,५०,००० ठेव, अधिसूचित व्याजदरासह
schemes.notes: Limited to two girl children per family, with narrow exceptions for twins. Sibling count is not modelled.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
schemes.description: Government-backed renewable annual term life cover for bank and post office account holders.
schemes.description_mr: बँक व पोस्ट खातेधारकांसाठी शासन पुरस्कृत वार्षिक नूतनीकरणीय मुदत जीवन विमा.
schemes.benefit: Rs 2,00,000 life cover for an annual premium of Rs 436
schemes.benefit_mr: वार्षिक ₹४३६ हप्त्यात ₹२,००,००० जीवन विमा संरक्षण

required_documents.name: Bank or post office savings account

schemes.notes: No income test. Requires a bank or post office account with auto-debit consent.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
schemes.description: Subsidised crop insurance protecting farmers against loss from natural calamities, pests and disease.
schemes.description_mr: नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, कीड व रोगामुळे होणाऱ्या पीक नुकसानीपासून शेतकऱ्यांना संरक्षण देणारा अनुदानित पीक विमा.
schemes.benefit: Farmer pays 2% of premium for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi and 5% for commercial crops; governments pay the rest
schemes.benefit_mr: खरीपासाठी २%, रब्बीसाठी १.५% व नगदी पिकांसाठी ५% हप्ता शेतकरी भरतो; उर्वरित शासन भरते
schemes.notes: Open to loanee and non-loanee farmers of any landholding size. No age or income test.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
schemes.description: Deposit-free LPG connection for adult women from poor households, replacing unsafe cooking fuels.
schemes.description_mr: गरीब कुटुंबातील प्रौढ महिलांना अनामत रकमेशिवाय एलपीजी जोडणी, असुरक्षित इंधनास पर्याय.
schemes.benefit: Rs 2,050 assistance for a 14.2 kg connection, plus free first refill and stove
schemes.benefit_mr: १४.२ किलो जोडणीसाठी ₹२,०५० सहाय्य, पहिली मोफत रिफिल व शेगडीसह
schemes.notes: Poverty status is established by self-declaration rather than a numeric figure. Household must have no existing LPG connection.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
schemes.description: Assistance to houseless rural households, and those in kutcha or dilapidated houses, to build a pucca house.
schemes.description_mr: बेघर ग्रामीण कुटुंबांना व कच्च्या घरात राहणाऱ्यांना पक्के घर बांधण्यासाठी अर्थसहाय्य.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,20,000 per house in plain areas (Rs 1,30,000 in hilly areas), plus toilet and wage-labour convergence
schemes.benefit_mr: सपाट भागात प्रति घर ₹१,२०,००० (डोंगराळ भागात ₹१,३०,०००), शौचालय व मजुरी सहाय्यासह
schemes.notes: Eligibility is SECC-2011 housing deprivation plus Gram Sabha verification. There is no income test.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
schemes.description: Maternity cash benefit for pregnant women and lactating mothers for their first living child.
schemes.description_mr: पहिल्या जिवंत अपत्यासाठी गर्भवती व स्तनदा मातांना मातृत्व रोख लाभ.
schemes.benefit: Rs 5,000 in three instalments, with a further Rs 1,000 available via Janani Suraksha Yojana
schemes.benefit_mr: तीन हप्त्यांत ₹५,०००, तसेच जननी सुरक्षा योजनेतून अतिरिक्त ₹१,०००
schemes.notes: Restricted to the first living child and excludes women already receiving paid maternity leave in government employment. Neither condition is in the resident record, so it is flagged for officer review.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
schemes.name_mr: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
schemes.description: Cashless hospitalisation cover for poor and vulnerable families identified through SECC data.
schemes.description_mr: एसईसीसी आधारे निवडलेल्या गरीब व वंचित कुटुंबांसाठी कॅशलेस रुग्णालय उपचार संरक्षण.
schemes.benefit: Rs 5,00,000 per family per year for hospitalisation at empanelled hospitals
schemes.benefit_mr: संलग्न रुग्णालयांत प्रति कुटुंब दरवर्षी ₹५,००,००० पर्यंत उपचार
schemes.notes: Real eligibility is a set of SECC deprivation codes (D1-D5, D7) or automatic-inclusion categories. Modelled here as SECC listing, which is an approximation.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Saur Krushi Pump Yojana
schemes.name_mr: मुख्यमंत्री सौर कृषी पंप योजना (मागेल त्याला सौर कृषी पंप योजना)
schemes.description: Provides subsidised solar-powered agricultural water pumps to farmers who lack a grid electricity connection.
schemes.description_mr: Provides subsidised solar-powered agricultural water pumps to farmers who lack a grid electricity connection.
schemes.benefit: Solar pump at 90-95% government subsidy: farmer pays only 10% (General category) or 5% (SC/ST category) of pump cost, e.g. Rs. 16,560 (General) or Rs. 8,280 (SC/ST) for a 3HP pump; Rs. 24,710/12,355 for 5HP; Rs. 33,455/16,728 for 7.5HP.
schemes.benefit_mr: Solar pump at 90-95% government subsidy: farmer pays only 10% (General category) or 5% (SC/ST category) of pump cost, e.g. Rs. 16,560 (General) or Rs. 8,280 (SC/ST) for a 3HP pump; Rs. 24,710/12,355 for 5HP; Rs. 33,455/16,728 for 7.5HP.
schemes.notes: Eligibility depends on land-holding size (up to 5 acres = 3HP; above 5 acres = 5HP/7.5HP), existing electrification status, and water-source depth for 7.5HP pumps — none of which fit the given criteria keys (no land-holding or infrastructure-status field exists). SC/ST caste category changes the subsidy percentage, which also cannot be expressed by the criteria schema (it affects benefit amount, not eligibility pass/fail). Document list not itemized on the fetched page; inferred from standard MSKPY/MahaDISCOM application requirements — verify before production use.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.description: Direct income support to landholding farmer families to help meet agricultural input costs.
schemes.description_mr: शेतीच्या निविष्ठा खर्चासाठी जमीनधारक शेतकरी कुटुंबांना थेट उत्पन्न सहाय्य.
schemes.benefit: Rs 6,000 per year in three instalments of Rs 2,000
schemes.benefit_mr: दरवर्षी ₹६,००० — ₹२,००० च्या तीन हप्त्यांमध्ये
schemes.notes: No numeric income ceiling published. Exclusions are categorical (income-tax payees, government employees, professionals, higher pensioners) and are not modelled.

schemes.name: Lek Ladki Yojana
schemes.description: Staged cash benefit paid to a girl child from a low-income yellow/saffron ration card family, from birth through age 18.
schemes.description_mr: Staged cash benefit paid to a girl child from a low-income yellow/saffron ration card family, from birth through age 18.
schemes.benefit: Total of Rs. 1,01,000 paid in installments up to age 18 (installments at birth, school milestones, and on turning 18).
schemes.benefit_mr: Total of Rs. 1,01,000 paid in installments up to age 18 (installments at birth, school milestones, and on turning 18).
schemes.notes: Eligibility is restricted to families holding Yellow or Saffron (Orange) ration cards specifically, and to the first one or two daughters born on/after 1 April 2023 (with a family-planning-certificate condition for later births) — none of this ration-card/birth-order logic fits the given criteria keys. gender:Female here refers to the beneficiary child, not an adult applicant.

schemes.name: Namo Shetkari Maha Samman Nidhi Yojana
schemes.description: Maharashtra state top-up income support to farmer families, paid alongside the central PM-KISAN scheme.
schemes.description_mr: Maharashtra state top-up income support to farmer families, paid alongside the central PM-KISAN scheme.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 6,000 per year (paid in 3 installments of Rs. 2,000), matching the central PM-KISAN Rs. 6,000/year for a combined Rs. 12,000/year to eligible farmer families.
schemes.benefit_mr: Rs. 6,000 per year (paid in 3 installments of Rs. 2,000), matching the central PM-KISAN Rs. 6,000/year for a combined Rs. 12,000/year to eligible farmer families.
schemes.notes: GAP: I could only confirm the Rs 6,000/year benefit figure, and only via Vikaspedia (a Government of India NIC-run reference portal, not one of the specifically-named Maharashtra sources) — a direct krishi.maharashtra.gov.in or mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in page for this scheme could not be fetched in this session (repeated ROBOTS_DISALLOWED/SSL errors, detailed below). Land-holding limits, the exact PM-KISAN-registration linkage rule, and any income/exclusion criteria (e.g. income-tax payers, government employees are typically excluded from PM-KISAN-linked schemes) are NOT verified here and must be re-checked against an official source before use. occupation_any is a reasonable proxy but the real eligibility gate is 'landholding farmer family already registered in the PM-KISAN database as of a specific cutoff date,' which cannot be expressed by that key alone.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
schemes.description: Direct monthly cash transfer to eligible women to support their financial independence and health.
schemes.description_mr: Direct monthly cash transfer to eligible women to support their financial independence and health.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 1,500 per month via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to an Aadhaar-linked bank account.
schemes.benefit_mr: Rs. 1,500 per month via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to an Aadhaar-linked bank account.
schemes.notes: Eligibility also requires the woman to be married, widowed, divorced, abandoned/destitute, or the sole unmarried woman in the family — a marital-status condition not expressible with the given criteria keys. Document list above is the commonly cited set; the official application portal (ladakibahin.maharashtra.gov.in) returned a 403 error when fetched directly in this session, so the document list was corroborated only via the pune.gov.in district scheme page and general public knowledge, not read verbatim off the state portal's own document checklist.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
schemes.name_mr: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धापकाळ निवृत्तिवेतन योजना
schemes.description: Social assistance pension for elderly persons from Below Poverty Line households.
schemes.description_mr: दारिद्र्यरेषेखालील कुटुंबातील ज्येष्ठ नागरिकांसाठी सामाजिक सहाय्य निवृत्तिवेतन.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,500 per month (central share plus Maharashtra top-up)
schemes.benefit_mr: दरमहा ₹१,५०० (केंद्र हिस्सा व महाराष्ट्र राज्याची भर)
schemes.notes: Central guideline says 60+. Maharashtra's own portal operates this band at 65+, bundling ages 60-64 into Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar. Confirm locally with the Tehsildar office before relying on the age used here.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
schemes.name_mr: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा निवृत्तिवेतन योजना
schemes.description: Social assistance pension for widows from Below Poverty Line households.
schemes.description_mr: दारिद्र्यरेषेखालील कुटुंबातील विधवांसाठी सामाजिक सहाय्य निवृत्तिवेतन.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,500 per month (central share plus Maharashtra top-up)
schemes.benefit_mr: दरमहा ₹१,५०० (केंद्र हिस्सा व महाराष्ट्र राज्याची भर)

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
schemes.name_mr: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय दिव्यांग निवृत्तिवेतन योजना
schemes.description: Social assistance pension for persons with severe or multiple disabilities from BPL households.
schemes.description_mr: दारिद्र्यरेषेखालील कुटुंबातील गंभीर किंवा बहुविध दिव्यांग व्यक्तींसाठी निवृत्तिवेतन.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,500 per month (central share plus Maharashtra top-up)
schemes.benefit_mr: दरमहा ₹१,५०० (केंद्र हिस्सा व महाराष्ट्र राज्याची भर)
schemes.notes: Official pages say 'severe or multiple disabilities' without publishing a percentage. The 40% threshold here follows the usual administrative convention and should be confirmed locally.

schemes.name: National Family Benefit Scheme
schemes.description: One-time assistance to a BPL household on the death of its primary breadwinner.
schemes.description_mr: कुटुंबातील प्रमुख कमावत्या व्यक्तीच्या मृत्यूनंतर दारिद्र्यरेषेखालील कुटुंबास एकरकमी सहाय्य.
schemes.benefit: One-time payment of Rs 20,000
schemes.benefit_mr: एकवेळचे ₹२०,००० अर्थसहाय्य
schemes.notes: The 18-59 age rule applies to the deceased breadwinner, not the applicant, so it cannot be evaluated against a living resident record. Flagged for officer review.

schemes.name: Rural Employment Guarantee (MGNREGA / successor programme)
schemes.description: Guaranteed wage employment on rural public works for households whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work.
schemes.description_mr: अकुशल शारीरिक कामासाठी इच्छुक प्रौढ सदस्य असलेल्या कुटुंबांना ग्रामीण सार्वजनिक कामांवर हमी रोजगार.
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed days of wage employment per household per year at the notified Maharashtra wage rate
schemes.benefit_mr: प्रति कुटुंब दरवर्षी हमी मजुरी रोजगार, महाराष्ट्रासाठी अधिसूचित दराने
schemes.notes: VERIFY BEFORE CITING. Research indicated MGNREGA was repealed in December 2025 and replaced by a successor Act raising the guarantee to 125 days and moving to a project-based model. This has not been independently confirmed. The scheme is recorded under a neutral name until you verify the current statute and wage rate.

schemes.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme
schemes.description: Merit and means scholarship helping economically weaker students continue study in classes IX to XII.
schemes.description_mr: आर्थिकदृष्ट्या दुर्बल विद्यार्थ्यांना इयत्ता ९वी ते १२वी शिक्षण सुरू ठेवण्यासाठी गुणवत्ता-सह-साधन शिष्यवृत्ती.
schemes.benefit: Rs 12,000 per year, paid monthly, for classes IX to XII
schemes.benefit_mr: इयत्ता ९वी ते १२वी साठी दरवर्षी ₹१२,००० (मासिक स्वरूपात)

required_documents.name: Class VII or VIII mark sheet

schemes.notes: Also requires passing a Mental Ability and Scholastic Aptitude Test with minimum marks. The exam gate cannot be evaluated from a resident record, so it is flagged for officer review.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra top-up)
schemes.name_mr: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय अपंग निवृत्तिवेतन योजना
schemes.description: Monthly pension for persons with disabilities, funded jointly by the central NSAP scheme and Maharashtra's Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Yojana.
schemes.description_mr: Monthly pension for persons with disabilities, funded jointly by the central NSAP scheme and Maharashtra's Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Yojana.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 1,500 per month total (Rs. 300 Central Government + Rs. 1,200 State Government top-up).
schemes.benefit_mr: Rs. 1,500 per month total (Rs. 300 Central Government + Rs. 1,200 State Government top-up).
schemes.notes: The fetched official page explicitly does NOT state an income limit or disability-percentage threshold for this specific scheme entry (unlike Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar/Shravan Bal, which state Rs 21,000/BPL). Under the central NSAP framework this scheme normally also requires BPL status and ≥80% disability, but since the Maharashtra SJSA page itself omitted these, max_income/disability-percentage were deliberately left out rather than invented — verify against nsap.nic.in guidelines before assuming a hard income cutoff. Document list not itemized on the official page; inferred from standard department practice.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (Maharashtra top-up)
schemes.name_mr: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा निवृत्तिवेतन योजना
schemes.description: Monthly pension for widows below the poverty line, funded jointly by the central NSAP scheme and Maharashtra's Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Yojana.
schemes.description_mr: Monthly pension for widows below the poverty line, funded jointly by the central NSAP scheme and Maharashtra's Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Yojana.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 1,500 per month total (Rs. 300 Central Government + Rs. 1,200 State Government top-up).
schemes.benefit_mr: Rs. 1,500 per month total (Rs. 300 Central Government + Rs. 1,200 State Government top-up).
schemes.notes: Eligibility is BPL-listed-family status, a categorical condition, NOT a numeric income figure — max_income was deliberately omitted rather than guessing a rupee equivalent for 'BPL'. Document list not itemized on official page; inferred from standard department practice.

schemes.name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulk Shishyavrutti Yojana (EBC)
schemes.name_mr: राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराज शिक्षण शुल्क शिष्यवृत्ती योजना
schemes.description: Tuition and examination fee reimbursement scholarship for Economically Backward Class (General/SEBC category) students in higher education.
schemes.description_mr: Tuition and examination fee reimbursement scholarship for Economically Backward Class (General/SEBC category) students in higher education.
schemes.benefit: 100% tuition fee (govt./aided institutions) for family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh; 50% tuition fee (all institution types) for income Rs 2.5-8 lakh for professional courses; 100% tuition + 100% exam fee for non-professional courses; 50% exam fee for professional courses.
schemes.benefit_mr: 100% tuition fee (govt./aided institutions) for family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh; 50% tuition fee (all institution types) for income Rs 2.5-8 lakh for professional courses; 100% tuition + 100% exam fee for non-professional courses; 50% exam fee for professional courses.

required_documents.name: Previous year mark sheet / attendance record

schemes.notes: Restricted to students admitted under General/SEBC category and to only the 'first two children' of a family — a category/birth-order rule the given criteria keys cannot express. Benefit tiers differently by sub-income-band (0-2.5L vs 2.5-8L) and by professional-vs-non-professional course, which a single max_income key flattens; a real implementation needs a tiered-benefit rule, not just an eligibility cutoff.

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme (Government of India, for SC students)
schemes.name_mr: भारत सरकार मॅट्रिकोत्तर शिष्यवृत्ती योजना (अनुसूचित जाती)
schemes.description: Centrally-sponsored, state-administered scholarship covering tuition, exam fees and maintenance allowance for Scheduled Caste students studying beyond Class 10.
schemes.description_mr: Centrally-sponsored, state-administered scholarship covering tuition, exam fees and maintenance allowance for Scheduled Caste students studying beyond Class 10.
schemes.benefit: Full tuition/exam/approved fees plus monthly maintenance allowance of Rs. 250-700 (non-hostel) or Rs. 400-1,350 (hostel), depending on course category, for family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh.
schemes.benefit_mr: Full tuition/exam/approved fees plus monthly maintenance allowance of Rs. 250-700 (non-hostel) or Rs. 400-1,350 (hostel), depending on course category, for family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh.
schemes.notes: Caste category (SC/Navbouddha) is a hard gate the given schema cannot express. Minimum education level ('studying above 10th std.') also has no matching key. Document list not fully itemized on the official page; the list above is a reasonable standard set but should be checked against the current MahaDBT applicant instructions.

schemes.name: Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana
schemes.description: Irrigation and farm-infrastructure subsidy scheme (well, drip irrigation, solar pump, electric pump, borewell) for Scheduled Tribe farmers.
schemes.description_mr: Irrigation and farm-infrastructure subsidy scheme (well, drip irrigation, solar pump, electric pump, borewell) for Scheduled Tribe farmers.
schemes.benefit: New irrigation well up to Rs. 4,00,000; drip irrigation 90% subsidy capped at Rs. 97,000; solar pump 90% subsidy capped at Rs. 50,000; electric pump (up to 10HP) 90% subsidy capped at Rs. 40,000; borewell up to Rs. 50,000.
schemes.benefit_mr: New irrigation well up to Rs. 4,00,000; drip irrigation 90% subsidy capped at Rs. 97,000; solar pump 90% subsidy capped at Rs. 50,000; electric pump (up to 10HP) 90% subsidy capped at Rs. 40,000; borewell up to Rs. 50,000.
schemes.notes: Eligibility requires land holding between 0.40 and 6.00 hectares in the farmer's own name (the 6-hectare ceiling is waived for BPL beneficiaries, and multiple ST farmers with sub-0.40-hectare fragmented holdings may apply jointly) — a land-area range and a BPL-conditional waiver that the given criteria keys cannot represent at all. Caste category (ST) is also a hard gate not expressible with the given keys. Sourced from a Zilla Parishad (Satara) portal since a direct krishi.maharashtra.gov.in/mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in fetch was blocked in this session (see prose section below) — cross-check figures against the MahaDBT Farmer scheme page before production use.

grievances.title: Drinking Water Tube-well Leakage
grievances.description: The primary tube-well near the Loni Kalbhor Maruti Temple has been leaking water for 3 days, causing waterlogging and low pressure in Ward 3 houses.

sabha.title: Loni Kalbhor Gram Sabha Monsoon Session
sabha.titleMr: लोणी काळभोर ग्रामसभा पावसाळी अधिवेशन बैठक
sabha.summary: The assembly focused on local monsoon preparedness. Key discussions revolved around the drainage overflow in Ward 2 weekly market, repairing the potholes in the main Ward 3 road before festival season, installing additional LED streetlights on school lanes for security, and checking pipeline expansion under ongoing water projects.
sabha.summaryMr: या बैठकीत प्रामुख्याने पावसाळ्यातील पूर्वतयारी आणि स्थानिक समस्यांवर लक्ष केंद्रित करण्यात आले. वॉर्ड २ मधील आठवडे बाजारातील गटार तुंबण्याची समस्या, सणासुदीच्या काळापूर्वी वॉर्ड ३ मधील रस्त्यावरील खड्डे दुरुस्त करणे, सुरक्षेसाठी शाळेच्या गल्लीत नवीन एलईडी दिवे बसवणे आणि सुरू असलेल्या पाणी पुरवठा प्रकल्पाच्या पाईपलाईन विस्ताराची तपासणी करणे या विषयांवर सखोल चर्चा झाली.
decisions: Approve ₹10,000 emergency fund for manual desilting of the weekly market drains.
Formally instruct the Junior Engineer to expedite estimation and repair of the Ward 3 road potholes.
Purchase 20 new LED streetlight luminaires using the unutilized general development fund.
decisionsMr: आठवडे बाजारातील गटारे स्वच्छ करण्यासाठी ₹१०,००० चा आपत्कालीन निधी मंजूर केला.
वॉर्ड ३ मधील रस्त्यावरील खड्डे दुरुस्तीचा अंदाज आणि काम त्वरित सुरू करण्यासाठी कनिष्ठ अभियंत्यांना निर्देश दिले.
न वापरलेल्या सामान्य विकास निधीमधून २० नवीन एलईडी पथदिवे खरेदी करण्यास मंजुरी दिली.
